Gorky lost his father when he was 4 years old and mother at the age of 11. He was brought up by his maternal grandparents. Gorky’s grandmother had a fondness for literature and compassion for the poor. He left home at the age of 12 and began a series of occupations, as an errand boy, a dish washer on a steamer, and apprentice to an icon maker. After the publication of his world famous novel ‘Mother’ in 1906 his reputation increased rapidly. From 1906 to 1913, Gorky lived on the island of Capri in southern Italy, partly for health reasons and partly to escape the increasingly repressive atmosphere in Russia. He was awarded 'Griboyedov’ prize in 1903. This great man breathed his last on 18 June 1936 in Moscow, Russia.

There is a highway on the upper level and a railway line on the lower level. It has 41 spans and each span is 150 meter long. Its length is 6150 m and width is 18.18 m. The project has taken 1062 hectares of land. The total cost of the bridge is Tk. 30.139.39 crore. This total overall construction work. This mega project has been inaugurated on 25 June 2022.
